proposed_capability: Use verified native crafting, consumed ingredient and sale/failure evidence to judge sustainable household robotics income.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only scoring in the existing native household policy. Never alters a player order, saves, game settings, or posts household money.
expected_outcome: Compare fully costed craft-and-sell routes, with same-build and household receipts driving projected and realized profit. Incomplete or losing routes do not become autonomous income recommendations.
negative_tests: Fee-only quote is not total cost.
Unsold and duplicated receipts do not increase net income.
Negative or break-even realized and projected margins hold the route.
Observed non-sale failure costs count against projected margin.
Cheats and unrelated funds changes are excluded.
Insufficient surplus blocks paid crafting even with positive projected profit.
rollback_path: Revert source feature and retain preexisting game and evidence state.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build EA robotics transaction hook and durable bridge to action receipts.
Actual materials acquisition costs, product proceeds and duration across recipes and sale channels.
